LanguageData.SZ_AnomaliesShiftedText: The emission has passed and the anomaly field has changed. The old anomalies are gone and new ones have formed elsewhere, possibly holding fresh artifacts.
LanguageData.SZ_ShelterOrdered: Emission approaching: colonists are heading for shelter. Drafted colonists stay where you put them.
LanguageData.SZ_CannotAttackAnomaly: An anomaly can't be attacked: it has no body to hit. Go around it.
LanguageData.SZ_RadiationSignTip:
Radiation hazard sign.
Marks the edge of contaminated ground. Staying inside causes radiation sickness.
